items.subtitle: Acceptance of Terms & Eligibility
items.content: By accessing or using the NIDA website, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please discontinue using this site immediately. You must be at least 20 years old or possess legal parental or guardian consent to use this service.

items.subtitle: Account Registration & Security
items.content: To place orders and enjoy member privileges, you may create a NIDA customer account. You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. Notify us immediately if you suspect any unauthorized access.

items.subtitle: Prohibited Conduct
items.content: You agree not to use the website for unlawful purposes or in violation of third-party rights. Prohibited conduct includes automated data scraping, reverse engineering, interfering with server security, or transmitting false information that could disrupt or damage our systems.

orders.title: Orders, Pricing & Payment Contract
orders.summary: Conditions governing order placement, confirmation, price and stock accuracy, payment methods, and cancellations.

items.subtitle: Order Placement & Acceptance
items.content: Placing an order constitutes an offer to purchase. A binding sales contract is formed once payment has been received and NIDA sends you an official Order Confirmation email. NIDA reserves the right to decline or cancel orders in cases of fraud suspicion, pricing discrepancies, or sudden inventory depletion.

items.subtitle: Pricing & Inventory Accuracy
items.content: All prices are listed in Thai Baht (THB) inclusive of VAT. While we strive for absolute accuracy, unexpected errors may occur. In the event of an erroneous price, NIDA reserves the right to contact you for confirmation at the correct price or cancel the order with a full refund.

items.subtitle: Payment Methods & Transaction Security
items.content: We support Credit/Debit Cards, PromptPay QR, and Cash on Delivery. Card payments are securely processed through Omise Payment Gateway in accordance with PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance. NIDA does not store your sensitive card details on our servers.

items.subtitle: Order Cancellation & Return Policy
items.content: Orders may be cancelled prior to dispatch. If an item has manufacturing defects, you may request an exchange or return within 7 days of delivery, provided that items are unworn, unwashed, and in their original packaging with all tags attached.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability & NIDA Trademarks

items.subtitle: Disclaimer & Limitation of Liability
